cvStructure.issue: Your CV has no Skills or Technical Skills section, even though you use many tools and platforms throughout Experience and Projects (AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, GitHub Actions, Prometheus, Grafana, Ansible, Helm).
cvStructure.suggestion: Add a Skills section near the top that lists these tools explicitly, so an ATS can match them easily.

keywordUsage.issue: Some tool names are not written in their official form: "Kubernets" should be "Kubernetes", "Git Hub Actions" should be "GitHub Actions", and "Terrafrom" should be "Terraform".
keywordUsage.suggestion: Correct these spellings in the Junior DevOps Engineer entry so the tool names match their official names exactly.

keywordUsage.issue: In the Cloud Operations Intern entry, the points "Monitoring", "Server stuff and deployments" and "Helping with tickets" use vague everyday wording instead of standard technical terms.
keywordUsage.suggestion: Rewrite these as specific action-based points, for example using terms like "server monitoring" or "incident ticket resolution" if that matches what you actually did.

readability.issue: The Cloud Operations Intern points "Monitoring", "Server stuff and deployments" and "Helping with tickets" are vague fragments rather than clear accomplishments starting with a strong action verb.
readability.suggestion: Rewrite each as a short specific point describing what you actually did, for example "Monitored [systems] using [tool]" or "Resolved [type] support tickets".

readability.issue: The Graduation project entry is written as a first-person story ("I worked on the servers part with my team and it was successful") and has no specific result.
readability.suggestion: Rewrite it as a short point starting with an action verb, and add a specific result such as [number] or [percentage] if you have one, for example "Built the server infrastructure for [project name], achieving [result]".

contentFormatting.issue: Your summary states "over 3 years of professional experience", but your Experience section only shows the Cloud Operations Intern role (Jun 2025 - Aug 2025) and the Junior DevOps Engineer role starting Mar 2026, which together total about a year, not 3 years.
contentFormatting.suggestion: Update the summary to match your actual experience length, or remove the specific year count if it is not accurate yet.

contentFormatting.issue: The Self-hosted Git server project only shows a year, "(2025)", while every other entry in your CV uses a Month Year format.
contentFormatting.suggestion: Add the specific month to this project's date so all dates in your CV follow the same Month Year format.
